name: add_springboot_tasktracker_filter_fix_dynamic
description: Repo-scale dynamic eval: TaskRepository.findAll silently drops filters when more than one is combined (if/else-if chain instead of independent continues); the fix is REVERTED after prompt 1 (fixed after_prompt trigger) and must be reapplied, this time covering all three filters combined at once
prompts: GET /tasks ignores some of its filters when more than one is passed together - e.g. projectId=X&status=DONE currently returns ALL of project X's tasks regardless of status, instead of just the DONE ones. Find and fix the bug in TaskRepository.findAll; every combination of projectId/status/assigneeId filters must apply together (AND), not just whichever one happens to be checked first.

The filter fix from before seems to have been lost - GET /tasks is back to ignoring combined filters. Reapply the fix in TaskRepository.findAll. This time also make sure combining ALL THREE filters at once (projectId AND status AND assigneeId together) returns the correct intersection, not just pairs of them.

disruptions.description: TaskRepository.java reverted back to the if/else-if chain bug, undoing prompt 1's fix
